analysis: Price has expanded above VAH despite negative spot and perpetual CVD deltas, indicating an inefficiency driven by passive absorption and short liquidations rather than spot buying conviction. key_risk: Acceptance back inside the Value Area below 83,550 triggering long liquidation cascades down to POC at 83,400.
